fields.Name: Action Log Retention
fields.Description: Purges expired MJ: Action Execution Logs rows, bounded per run. Retention is decided when the log row is written — StartActionLog stamps RetentionPeriod from the action's own setting — so editing an action's retention changes what is kept going forward rather than retroactively deleting history. A row with no retention is kept indefinitely unless DefaultRetentionDays is configured here. Optional Configuration: { "DefaultRetentionDays": <number>, "MaxDeletesPerRun": <number> }; MaxDeletesPerRun defaults to 5000, so a first run against a long-neglected table cannot become an unbounded transaction — it drains oldest-first over successive runs.
